title: Automatic-Debit Credit on the Rural Home Loans Escrow Waiver Fee — Member Terms
content:
**Member terms.** A Rural Home Loans loan paying by automatic debit receives a credit on the escrow waiver fee.

## Credit

An automatic-debit credit is taken off the fee: 25.00 USD for a loan paying by automatic debit with no returned remittance in the 24 months up to today, 10.00 USD for a loan paying by automatic debit with a returned remittance in those months, and nothing for a loan not on automatic debit. The credit is subtracted from the fee after the fee rate has been applied and every percentage taken off it; the fee is that figure rounded to the cent, never below zero, rounded only at the end.

| Automatic debit enrolled on the loan record | Returned remittance in the 24 months | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| yes | none | 25.00 |
| yes | one or more | 10.00 |
| no | any | none |

A returned remittance is a principal payment return entry on the home loan dated from the day after the same calendar day 24 months before today through today.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- A fee figure of 498.75 on a loan paying by automatic debit with no return in 24 months: 498.75 less 25.00 is 473.75.
- A fee figure of 18.40 with a 25.00 credit: the result would be below zero, so the fee is 0.00.
